description: This file defines the CustomFieldController class in the OrangeHRM project, responsible for managing custom fields related to employee data screens within the application. It includes constants for various screens and field types, methods for retrieving associated services, and prepares data for rendering the UI component.

classes.name: CustomFieldController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling custom fields configuration and rendering related UI components in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getCustomFieldService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of CustomFieldService used for managing custom fields.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares UI component with necessary properties for rendering the custom fields list interface, including screen list, field types, and current custom fields in use.
